scope: Synthetic in-page backend; renderer only. No native IPC, real-cluster, compositor-pixel or M1 certification.
projection: Allowlisted metadata and scalar summaries. Raw profiles, time series, paths and payloads remain private. Original JSON SHA-256 digests identify source receipts.
finding: The unreleased per-cell metric bridge published from useLayoutEffect after the parent commit, forcing one extra commit per metric reply. Removing the bridge and memoizing the metric presenter removes that phase. This does not uniquely explain all earlier wall-time fluctuations.

acceptance.noResourceUpdates1x: Improved in fresh clean-build trials; 24,000 px delivered each time, driver lateness p95 under 2 ms. Frame p95 remains above 20 ms.
acceptance.noResourceUpdates4x: Baseline input backpressure invalidates percentage-speedup acceptance. Candidate median frame p95 83.4 ms still fails smoothness goal.
acceptance.liveUpdates: FAILED. Baseline inputs did not deliver the complete path. Candidate delivered full path at 1x but frame p95 66.7 ms; 4x candidate also suffered input backpressure and median p95 966.6 ms. Longer windows receive more updates, so total CPU time is not a fair speedup comparison.
acceptance.merge: Keep coordinated PRs in draft; no smooth-scrolling acceptance or merge.

controlledDiagnostics.scope: Diagnostic only: DevTools commit hook and DOM counters enabled; no CPU sampler or trace. Fixed view, ten metric replies, no resource changes, no row churn. Not an accepted whole-app speed test.

controlledDiagnostics.tradeoff: On the constant old runtime, memoized presentation alone removed the extra commits but used more JavaScript than the per-cell variant in the frequent-refresh stress. The final clean runtime also removes the bridge itself. Preserve all diagnostic trials rather than hiding this tradeoff.

finalCleanFixedRefreshDiagnostics.scope: Whole clean builds, ABBA order, 4x CPU, 500 ms metric refresh, five-second fixed view after two-second warmup. Candidate retains larger overscan. Diagnostic only; two samples per build do not establish timing acceptance.
